reviews.text: It’s one of the best lip products I have ever had. The color, the texture it’s amazing
reviews.zh: 呢款係我用過最好嘅唇部產品之一。顏色、質地都超靚

reviews.text: Really pretty cool tone shade. I like using this as a base. It seems light but the tint is darker. Smells good.
reviews.zh: 好靚嘅冷調色號。我鍾意用佢做 base。睇落淺色，但上色比較深。味道好聞。

reviews.text: Another favorite. Doesn’t make my lip try. Glossy and moisturized
reviews.zh: 又一款心頭好。唔會令嘴唇乾。光澤感又保濕

reviews.text: Very pretty and hydrating! It does have a slight fragrance
reviews.zh: 好靚又保濕！有少少香味

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
